text: I see you're in severe distress; to help me pinpoint the cause of your abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and dysuria, have you noticed any fever or changes in your urine color? Also, is the pain localized to a specific area, such as the lower right side?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyelonephritis with concurrent cervicitis.
